Quality and Efficiency of Implementation.criterion_name: Quality and efficiency of the implementation
Quality and Efficiency of Implementation.source_section: Section 3. Quality and efficiency of the implementation — Score 3 (0-5): Weighting: 20%

compliance_checklist.description: Scope of the application: the application must be 'in scope' because it corresponds, wholly or in part, to the topic description against which it has been submitted. If out of scope, a detailed explanation is required and this must be reflected in scoring.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2. Other Questions — Scope of the application

compliance_checklist.description: Exclusive focus on civil applications: activities intended to be used in military applications or serving military purposes cannot be funded. Evaluator must confirm that proposed activities have an exclusive focus on civil applications.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2. Other Questions — Exclusive focus on civil applications

compliance_checklist.description: Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC): evaluator must confirm whether the proposal involves hESC use. If yes, evaluator must assess whether such use is necessary to achieve the scientific objectives and provide justification or flag inability to assess due to lack of information.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2. Other Questions — Use of human embryonic stem cells (hESC)

compliance_checklist.description: Use of human embryos: evaluator must confirm whether the proposal involves the use of human embryos. If yes, evaluator must explain how human embryos will be used in the project.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2. Other Questions — Use of human embryos

compliance_checklist.description: Activities excluded from funding: the proposal must not include activities that (a) aim at human cloning for reproductive purposes, (b) intend to modify the heritable genetic heritage of human beings (except cancer treatment of gonads), (c) intend to create human embryos solely for research or stem cell procurement including via somatic cell nuclear transfer, or (d) lead to the destruction of human embryos (e.g. for obtaining stem cells).
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2. Other Questions — Activities excluded from funding

compliance_checklist.description: Exceptional funding for third country participants or international organisations not listed in the General Annex to the Main Work Programme: participation must be individually justified as essential for carrying out the project (e.g. outstanding expertise, access to unique know-how, research infrastructure, particular geographical environments, key partners in emerging markets, access to data). Each such participant and requested grant amount must be listed with justification.

Lump sum cost estimation assessment (applicable for lump sum topics only): evaluator must assess the cost estimations and include either approval of the lump sum budget or concrete recommendations for modification in the evaluation report.
compliance_checklist.source_section: Section 2. Other Questions — Assessment of lump sum cost estimations (additional OPTION for lump sum topics)
